title: Ansible Flow scenario tests
description: Scenario tests for the flow next to this file (<key>.scenarios.yaml, AFD-58). Each scenario runs every step as its stub on local-connection hosts, forces the outcomes listed, and checks where each host ends.

flow.description: The key of the flow these scenarios test (the flow next to this file).

scenarios.description: The scenarios, run one after another.

name.description: What the scenario shows, unique in the file.

inputs.description: Run inputs. The flow's targets input (a host_list) lists the hosts the scenario runs on.

groups.description: Inventory groups for patterns the flow uses besides its targets (inventory_target): group -> hosts.

force.description: Outcomes to force: step key (or subflow/step inside a subflow) -> outcome -> hosts. failed sends hosts down failed_hosts; unreachable, timeout and unchanged need that port enabled; false applies to decisions (they take true otherwise).

approvals.description: Approval key -> outcome for this run (default approved).

expect.description: Host -> where it must end: an end node key (subflow/end inside a subflow), or <step>.<port> for an output nobody wired.
